instances.claim: This tells me that the work is never finished and its meaning keeps changing — and then tells me again, and then once more.
instances.why: All three sit in the same register (the status of the work's value over time) and make one point: redefinition is ongoing. 17's 'ongoing process of redefinition' and 22's 'continually redefined' are the same sentence in different word order — 22 also echoes the exact phrase already spent on line 16 — while 23's 'unfolds continually' repeats it a third time; 23 at least adds the form ('is a becoming') and the participants who do the redefining, so it is the one carrying something 17 and 22 do not.
